name: budget-book
description: Open-source budget management for individuals and teams: budgets, expenses, bill splitting, forecasts and Excel, Slack and calendar integrations.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w @budget-book/api" "npm run dev -w @budget-book/web"
scripts.docker:dev: node scripts/setup.mjs && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f api web
